knownBoundaryControls.label: PADIS focused update belongs to guideline consideration; observed review reservoir is not a search miss.
Ketamine co-publications are one recommendation family, not newer versus superseded editions.
ARDS main guideline and executive summary are one family with distinct document roles.
Narrow ICU hematologic-emergency review has plausible clinical relevance; held fit judgment needs context, not automatic promotion.

limits: Positive-only convenience sample cannot estimate precision, specificity, or recall.
Development/holdout split is stratified by track but not balanced for recency: only one holdout case is current.
No historical rank is invented from current helper outputs. No fetched abstract is fabricated from a clinical rationale.
No clinical text, queue, status, adoption, or publication history was changed.
Source verification is metadata/abstract level and partial for blocked publisher pages.
